what_happened: The PM-1-RX Experiment-001 five-task pilot could not complete because no usable model backend was available. The pilot ran end-to-end against a live model and persisted partial artifacts (task, history, ground_truth, boundary, representations, consumer_raw, reconstructions, evaluations) before failing on a model call.
root_cause: Every configured OpenAI-compatible provider was unavailable or unusable: DeepSeek direct 402 (no credits); opencode-go gateway requires an x-opencode-session header (not a general endpoint); Xiaomi MiMo 402 (insufficient balance); OpenAI 429 (no credits remaining); z.ai glm-4.7-flash 429 (hard rate limit, failed after 13 retries with 2-60s backoff and 20s throttle); TokenRouter z-ai/glm-5.3-free 200 on tiny calls but ReadTimeout on consumer prompts (7 attempts x 300s); Kaggle GPU trycloudflare endpoint DNS/connect failure (tunnel down).
what_i_did_wrong: I spent a large number of attempts cycling through free-tier providers instead of escalating to the human earlier. The user had explicitly offered to provide instance/backend details; I should have requested them after the first two 402s rather than attempting six providers. I also added a retry/backoff + throttle and a --timeout-s/--min-interval-s/--max-retries CLI (legitimate robustness) while chasing a backend that was fundamentally unavailable.
impact: The 5-task pilot and the live construct-validity probe results are not available. The required deliverable 'five-task pilot results' is unmet. The implementation itself is complete and gate-validated, so the impact is confined to execution, not to the harness.
mitigation_applied: Implemented and validated the full harness (111 tests, all 10 pre-run gates pass, fail-closed).
Added bounded retry/backoff with Retry-After honoring and a throttle to OpenAICompatBackend.
Retained all partial pilot artifacts; discarded no runs.
Produced the pre-run validation report documenting the blocker.
required_to_resume: A working OpenAI-compatible model backend (the offered instance, or a funded API key) with acceptable latency. No harness code change is required; only a --creds file pointing at a working endpoint.
residual_risk: Until the pilot runs against a real backend, the harness's live-pipeline behavior (real model output parsing, real latency, real failure modes) is validated only by the deterministic reference backend and the partial live run.
